sentences.text:
Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr vs 9.12.17 State Of
West Bengal & Ors on 19 December, 2017

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
 1
 W.P. No.30198 (W) of 2017
 Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr.
 v.
19.12.17 State of West Bengal & Ors.
Sl-13
Ct-13 Mr. Ranjan Bachawat
(S.R.) Mr. Shwashish Sen Gupta

Mr. Manoj Kumar Tiwari
 Mrs. A. Goyal Agarwal ... for the petitioners.

Mr. Amitesh Banerjee
 Mr. Tarak Karan ... for the State.

Mr. A. Ghosh
 Mr. Arijit Dey ... for the Kmc.

Mr. Jayanta Majumder ... for the respondent no.7.
Mr. Asis Mukherjee ... for the respondent no.8.
Affidavit of service filed in Court be kept with the record.

The grievance of the petitioners is non-issuance of licence under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 as also the trade licence under the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act,
1980.

Learned senior advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that, under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 read with the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, an officer of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 1980 is designated for the purpose of considering and granting a licence under the Act of 2006 and also for considering exemption.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The State, the KMC, and the respondent nos.7 and 8 are represented.

In the given facts of the present case, it would be appropriate to permit the members of the Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr vs 9.12.17 State Of West Bengal & Ors on 19 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65877299/
1 petitioners to apply online in the prescribed format for cnversion of the licence/registration.

entities.text: Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr vs 9.12.17 State Of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Upon such an application being made, the appropriate authority will consider it, in accordance with law.

In the event, the appropriate authority finds any impediment in complying with the request made by the petitioners, he will convene a meeting with the authorised representative of the members of the petitioners and will afford a reasonable opportunity to members of the petitioners to cure the defects, if there be any.
In the event, he is not in a position to keep the request of the members of the petitioners, he will pass a reasoned order which he will communicate to the petitioners forthwith thereafter.
It is expected that, the appropriate authority will complete the entire exercise within a period of fortnight from the date of communication of the application by the members of the petitioners.
All points raised by the parties are kept open.
W.P. No.30198 (W) of 2017 is disposed of accordingly.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Urgent certified website copies of this order, if applied for, be made available to the parties upon compliance of the requisite formalities.

(Debangsu Basak, J.)
